# 01 Printing

Print the 14 parts listed in [`print/`](../../print/): 9 STL files, most of them printed twice because the
legs are mirror images.

- **Settings:** your printer's default PLA profile. The reference robot was printed on a stock Ender-3 V2.
- **Supports:** wherever your slicer asks for them.
- **`ankle_and_hip.stl` (×4):** this is the exception. It is the part most likely to break in a fall, so print
  it **tilted 45°** on the bed with **at least 6 walls**. Print a spare.

Clean off the supports and check that each servo slides into its pocket before you start assembling.
